definition: Jitendra Malik (born 11 October 1960) is an Indian-American academic who is the Arthur J.
details: Chick Professor of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences at the University of California, Berkeley. He is known for his research in computer vision.
story: Picture walking through a crowd and instantly picking out a familiar face without reading a single name tag. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. Sight, for a machine, is a long climb from raw light to a name. And that is Jitendra Malik — giving a machine the gift of sight.
